device: Apple M5 GPU, 24 GiB shared system memory

training.checkpoint_rule: Use final fixed-budget checkpoint. Adapt resources/update count after the 20-step timing probe and before validation/test; record amendment and match branch budgets.
training.alias_construction: serialized formula and fixed redundant outer-parenthesis variant, validated and token-deduplicated

evaluation.usage_note: Separate local-model experiment; old controller request caps and temperature do not apply. No paid API.

primary_comparison: Canonical coverage versus matched balanced SFT, paired by held-out observation set
success_rule: Report RR difference and task-bootstrap interval with VR/NR. Provisional practical target: +5 percentage points RR, no more than 2 percentage points VR loss versus balanced SFT. These are selection criteria, not predicted gains.

method_boundary.core_mechanism: offline LoRA training on official structural classes
method_boundary.test_conditioning: original observations and task rules only
method_boundary.alias_role: fixed serialized/outer-parenthesis training encodings; no LLM rewriting
method_boundary.teammate_direction: DCHG inference conditioned on specified prediction differences, as described by user

group_comparison.fresh_joint_test_rule: Exclude union of both methods training, validation, tuning and development-selection task IDs; do not relabel development results as an independent test.
